test_BatchNorm_basic: test the BatchNorm layer with basic training and inference mode on 3D input data
test_BatchNorm_NCHW: test the BatchNorm layer with NCHW data format and custom scale and offset parameters
test_BatchNorm_custom_axes: test the BatchNorm layer with custom normalized axes for selective dimension normalization
test_BatchNorm_cross_replica: test the BatchNorm layer with cross-replica axis using jax pmap for multi-device training
test_BatchNorm_dtype_preservation: test the BatchNorm layer dtype preservation when casting between float32 and bfloat16
